cases.compatible_direct_campaign_components: Two disjoint, source-grouped direct campaign costs may be added only after all measurement dimensions agree.
cases.incompatible_organisation_campaign: An organisation statement amount cannot be combined with, or promoted to, a campaign amount.
cases.incompatible_allocated_direct: An allocated component and a direct component remain separate.
cases.incompatible_possible: A possible component is retained for a bounds envelope, not deterministic addition.
cases.incompatible_excluded: An excluded component is retained as a reasoned exclusion, not an expense fact.
